changes: Critical fix: the @mention dropdown was listing duplicates — anyone who's both a Board member and has tipped (e.g. Josh, Joffa) appeared twice, once under their Board name and once under their separately self-set Tipping name. The tipping-side list wasn't excluding people already added from the Board roster, unlike the Casino leaderboard elsewhere in the app which already does this correctly. Fixed to match that same, correct pattern.
